data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of $167.2m (2015: favourable run off deviation of $12.3m) was experienced during the year in respect of various lines of business. The most significantly releases were within energy ($75.5m), reinsurance ($34.3m), casualty ($26.8m), financial lines ($24.7m) and marine ($21.1m). These were partially offset by increases in accident & health ($15.7m). This is mainly due to a reduction in the ultimate loss estimates.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2016 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were $3,953.344m. During 2016 there was a net favourable prior-accident-year run-off of $167.2m (a release), driven by reductions in ultimate loss estimates across several classes - notably Energy, Reinsurance, Casualty, Financial Lines and Marine - partially offset by increases in Accident & Health. The overall prior-year movement is therefore a release of approximately 4.2% of opening gross claims outstanding.

data.data_quality_notes: All statement amounts are presented in the syndicate's reporting currency (USD). Monetary fields in this JSON are expressed in millions (consistent with other fields) except the claims development triangle which uses the table's native units (thousands). The prior-year development figure (-$167.2m) is taken from the movement narrative ('Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding') and is reported gross as stated; confidence is high for the magnitude but the narrative is the source rather than a tabular gross movement line. The claims development triangle was parsed from the gross claims development table; the '2011 & Prior' aggregate column was excluded per instructions and some early-period row alignment required interpretation from the printed table (hence reduced confidence on the triangle extraction). Some page numbering reflects PDF printed pages where the items appear.
